tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Page background and sidebar; the deepest layer (level 0).

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, containers, large dark pill buttons (level 1).

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Button backgrounds, search input, interactive surfaces (level 1).

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Elevated card surface and the hover state of bg-surface cards.

tokens.name: bg-card-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate card surface for adjacent cards.

tokens.name: bg-light
tokens.usage: Light pill buttons only (consent banners, marketing CTAs). Never a page surface.

tokens.name: text-base
tokens.usage: Primary text and active nav, on bg-base, bg-surface, bg-elevated, bg-card (15.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-subdued
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, inactive nav, on bg-base through bg-card (7.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-bright
tokens.usage: Slightly brighter secondary text, on any dark surface.

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Near-pure white for maximum emphasis, on any dark surface.

tokens.name: on-light
tokens.usage: Text on bg-light (15.3:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single brand accent: play controls, active states, primary CTAs. Functional only, never decorative or a background area.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Green accent border variant, e.g. an active outlined control.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Icons and labels on accent fills (10.9:1).

tokens.name: text-negative
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on dark surfaces (6.7:1 on bg-base). Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: text-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on dark surfaces (9.4:1 on bg-base).

tokens.name: text-announcement
tokens.usage: Info and announcement text on dark surfaces (6.7:1 on bg-base).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Button borders on dark and the unfilled part of progress bars. Decorative only: 2.2:1 on bg-base, below the 3:1 floor for meaningful borders.

tokens.name: border-muted
tokens.usage: Outlined pill borders, inset input borders, muted links (4.5:1 on bg-base).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Divider lines.

tokens.name: ink-inset
tokens.usage: Colour of the 1px top line in shadow-inset.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: 2px keyboard focus outline on every control (18.7:1 on bg-base). The source defines only a black input focus border, which is invisible on dark grounds.
